changelog: Fixes the artwork added in 1.0.23.0 not appearing in the playback overlays: the pause panel's and next-up card's posters were loaded lazily, and an image in an overlay that has not been laid out yet has no height - so the browser never got round to loading it and the picture never arrived.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
